title_original: 사회서비스 지원 및 사회서비스원 설립ㆍ운영에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
ADDENDA <Decree of the Ministry of Health and Welfare No. 875, Mar. 24, 2022>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules enter into force on March 25, 2022.

Article 2 (Special Cases concerning Management Evaluations, etc. of City/Do Institutes)
(1) Notwithstanding Article 3 (1), where one year has not elapsed since the date of registration of establishment of a City/Do Institute as of the end of a fiscal year, the Minister of Health and Welfare may, as determined by the Minister, omit evaluations, etc. for the fiscal year in which that date of registration falls.
(2) Notwithstanding Article 3 (3), the head of a City/Do Institute established on or before December 31, 2020 may submit materials for evaluations, etc. conducted after these Rules enter into force to the Minister of Health and Welfare by April 30, 2022.
